titleStmt.title: Record of Decisions of the Tenth Meeting of the Council of Foreign Ministers, London, September 18, 1945

head.hi: Record of Decisions of the Tenth Meeting of the Council of Foreign Ministers, London, September 18, 1945

div.p: [1. Italy: Procedure for Preparing Peace Treaty

Statements were made by the representatives of the Australian, New Zealand and South African Governments on the procedure for consultation with Governments not represented on the Council which were directly interested in the peace settlement with Italy].
2. Italian Peace Treaty: Yugoslav–Italian Frontier and Trieste

p.hi: Views of Governments of British Dominions

div.p: The views of the Australian Government on this question were stated to the Council by Dr. H. V. Evatt. A summary of Dr. Evatt’s statement has been circulated separately as C.F.M. (45) 28.
The views of the New Zealand Government were stated to the Council by Mr. R. M. Campbell. The text of Mr. Campbell’s statement is reproduced in C.F.M. (45) 29.
The views of the South African Government were stated to the Council by Mr. Heaton Nicholls. A summary of Mr. Nicholls’ statement has been circulated separately as C.F.M.(45) 30.

p.hi: Further views of the Yugoslav Government

div.p: M. Kardelj made a further statement in reply to the views expressed by the representative of the Italian Government at the Council’s meeting that afternoon (C.F.M.(P) (45) 9th Meeting).
A summary of M. Kardelj’s statement has been circulated separately as C.F.M.(45) 31.

note.p: At their 27th meeting on September 29, 1945, the Council of Foreign Ministers approved this Record of Decisions after eliminating section 1 (printed here in brackets). For the record of the Council’s tenth meeting, see C.F.M.(P) (45) 10th Meeting, p. 239.
